data.gender_notes: Mufinella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew words ‘El’ meaning God and ‘Yeladah’ meaning little one, Mufinella is a name given to a precious child of God. This name symbolizes the protection and love of the Almighty towards His children. The name Mufinella carries the meaning “God's little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Mufinella usually hope their child will grow to embody god's little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine love and protection.
data.etymology: Mufinella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufinella total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mufinella is rooted in its Hebrew origins. El, the prefix of the name, means ‘God’, highlighting the belief that each child is a gift from God and is under His divine protection.
